findings.message: ADD CHECK scans users under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE; add it NOT VALID, then VALIDATE CONSTRAINT in its own step
findings.detail: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on users, held for a full scan; blocks reads and writes
findings.fix:
-- +mig step: add_users_score_positive_not_valid
-- NOT VALID: the check holds for new rows at once, no scan yet
ALTER TABLE users ADD CONSTRAINT users_score_positive CHECK (score > 0) NOT VALID;

-- +mig step: validate_users_score_positive
-- +mig notx
-- the scan happens here, blocking neither reads nor writes
ALTER TABLE users VALIDATE CONSTRAINT users_score_positive;
